about.title: I’m Bray.

who.heading: Who I am
paragraphs: Hi. I’m Bray, a web developer from the United States. I studied business, and I spent three months in Cusco where I found something that matters: the technical quality I bring from my training in the US, together with genuine respect for how you work here, is what makes the difference.
I’m not here to sell you a generic solution. I work directly with real businesses, person to person. A website isn’t a luxury. It’s your shop, your storefront, your relationship with your customers.
I love this culture. The way of working, the people, the trust you build. That’s why I’m here. Estudio Bray exists to make sites that work the way you need. No jargon and no empty promises.

how.heading: What you can expect
paragraphs: Speed, close communication, and a site built around you.
A website usually takes three or four months. With me, a lot less. We talk on WhatsApp. You see it soon. We adjust until it fits.

needs.heading: What helps me
needs.intro: If you can send these, the site will feel more like you. It’s fine if you don’t have everything yet.
